title: Leave Terrorism and Follow Allah's Divine Rules
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa
lillahi ‘l-hamd. Allahuma salli `ala Sayyidina Muhammad Sayyid al-aawwaleena wa’l-aakhireen. Habeebika
wa Rasoolika ya rabb al-`alameen ya rabb zid-hu `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, ridwaana wa
sultanaan ya Akramal-akrameen. Yaa Rabb ighfir lana wa tub `alayna, yaa Tawwab, yaa Allah! (Mawlana
Shaykh sits)
Madad, yaa Rijaalullah. Yaa Rabb, amiduna bi madadihim. Nahnu `abeedika ad-dua`fa, qawwiyyna `ala
`adaaina, khudhhum akhdhan `azeezan muqtadiran.
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem. Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmani ‘r-Raheem. As salaamu `alaykum
ayyuhal-hadiroon ayyuhas-sami`een isma`oo wa aawooo.
O Listeners! Listen and keep it as you will find heavenly support if you keep heavenly people's advice. They
may also make a donkey speak to you (instead of us). For us, it is not so difficult; I am not claiming I come
here to teach you, because I am perhaps the weakest servant. But if they are giving support, like an atom that
can kick dunya from east to west, from west to east, it is so easy for them if they are granted heavenly powers,
which you cannot measure! Even an atom's power may kick this Earth from east to west with the support of

its Creator. But Mankind is heedless now, trying to do everything on this planet as they like, according to
their technology. No! (You must know that) an atom may kick the whole world from its orbit into space by the
order of its Creator.
O People! They are making me address such things to all Mankind because now, in our days, Mankind is so
proud, thinking they have such power, when in reality an atom may kick the whole world from its orbit into
space! What about countless atoms all around us on our planet? They are not running to the sun's solar
system, because if given that order, an atom may kick out (whatever it is ordered), and can make our solar
system to be in unseen worlds or to fall into a black hole (never to reappear)! Allahu Akbar al-Akbar! Allahu
Akbar al-Akbar! Allah, Allah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
But now Man is so proud, and pride's origin is from Shaytan. Shaytan makes Man proud, but what you are
now saying makes Shaytan’s endless tricks and traps nothing in comparison, not even an atom. And when
ordering an atom, the Lord of Heavens is not speaking to that atom; rather, He makes one holy one say on
behalf of the Most Holy One in all Creation, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), Sayyid al-Awwaleen, Noor as-Sultaan,
zid-hu yaa Rabb `izzan wa sharafan, nooran wa sultaanan. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) But people now
are drunk, and when drunk they are heedless, never thinking. You can find in Holy Qur'an the Holy Words of
Heaven, asking more than a hundred times, “O People! Think on it, think on it.” But they are not thinking on
anything because they are drunk on shaytanic ideas.
Man is now in two kinds of drunkenness: one group is drunk from what they are drinking; the other group
doesn’t need to drink from cups because Shaytan is putting something in their egoistic being and that makes
them drunk. The second group is now the majority, drunk from their inspired by shaytanic ideas and egoistic
beings. Those who are drunk never take any care for any heavenly messages or heavenly messengers, saying,
“No, we are here, we are not in need of heavenly things, we are not believing, and we can arrange everything
the way we know it.” That is the general view of all states on Earth. When you remind them, including Arabs
and other Muslims around the world, they do not listen to heavenly messages of Allah Almighty, and they are
asking, “Democracy.” This Prophet (s) is saying to you what the Lord of Heavens sending to him: the Holy
Qur`an, Holy Shari`ah. They are not asking.
Egypt, Damascus, Turks, Iraqis, Iran, Yemenis, Sudan, Tunis, people of the Islamic territories, Pakistan,

Afghanistan, Bangladeshis, all of them are not asking for Shari`atullah, the Holy Shari`ah; rather, they are
saying, “We are democratic.” Kharra `alayhum, crap on them! All of them are asking for democratic system.
Why are they not asking for Shari`atullah? Democracy is from shaytans, it is a system that makes people
slaves of dictators! Jahannamiyoon! They are never going to be successful after this month, Rajabun
shahrullah, Rajab is the sacred month of Allah, which begins in fifteen days; afterwards they are never going
to be successful, finished! They have closed all chances they were granted to understand Shari`atullah; they
opened Shaytan's ideas and now they are going to be closed down, finished!
Some claim, “We are defenders of al-Islam!” But even they are not running to implement Shari`atullah, the
Holy Shari`ah; rather, they are running to different countries and making terror. I never heard them saying
they are trying to bring Shari`atullah. Leave the non-Muslim world as you must look after your territories. In
Muslim countries, which one is using Shari`atullah? Woe upon them, as on the Day of Resurrection they will
be thrown into the seventh level of fire, because they are not saying, “Bring Shari`atullah.” Egypt claims they
are the highest authority in Islamic religion, yet even they are not saying we must bring Shari`atullah,
because if they say it, Allah Almighty’s order is that the first obligation for the whole Islamic world is to bring
a sultan for them, an imaam who should be sultan from East to West, from North to South, over the entire
Islamic world. But they have hubb ad-dunya, hubb ar-riyaasat, they love dunya and their thrones too much!
You have one throne, you have one throne... no one as a throne!
Every nation fears from the people of China. Why, because their population is two billion? Perhaps there are
two billion Muslims. Why are people not fearing Islam, but they fear China? They are never thinking on it.
They fear it because the Chinese territory is under one person's command. If he says, “War,” all people must
obey; if he says “Peace,” they must all follow him. The Arabs have similar numbers but the world does not
fear them, no one takes any notice of them. Why? Because we are like a dragon with fifty heads, not one head.
Therefore, people don’t care about Muslims but they fear China!
Wailun! This is a heavenly warning to the whole Muslim world: if it won’t come together under one leader,
Allah Almighty will send some of His creatures to discipline them. “I am sending a person to train you how
you can make the whole world under your control.” Yes. China is saying now, “Don’t touch Syrians, we
support them.” Even America is trembling, even the European Union, even Russia is trembling from the
“yellow dragon”! Whole world fears them. And Allah Almighty is saying, jalla min qaa`il:

•••••••••••••• •••••••• •••••• •••••••
wa tasimoo bi habb lillahi jami`an. Hold fast to the Rope of Allah altogether. (Surat Aali-`Imraan, 3:103)
Allah Almighty is saying, “You must keep My Shari’ah! What I sent you, keep it all together; you must not be
divided into forty states.”
Now there is no value for us. Damascus is depending on China, others are depending on the US. Some of
them are saying, “We are not this part, nor that part.” For what? Allah Almighty says Islam should be united,
“Come all together,” and the Seal of Prophets (s) said, “O People! When you join altogether, Allah Almighty
protects and supports you with heavenly powers.”
Don’t fear one or even seven China’s; they cannot defeat you, as mentioned in hadeeth ush-shareef:
•• •••• •••• •• •••• ••• ••••• •• •••
Lani aghali ummatee `ashara alf min ummatee min kullati.
It means, twelve-thousand real Muslims can’t be defeated, even if the whole world comes against them! You
can’t say, “They (Muslims) are only a handful of people, they must be defeated.” We are now two billion
Muslims, and we are afraid! What do Europeans know? What do they have now? What have the Christian
and Jewish worlds prepared against the Muslim world? Nothing! Why are people afraid of the non-Muslim
world and the heavenly ones now are shouting, sending a declaration, “Why are you fearing the non-Muslim
world’s weapons?” One man from you can blow and make all the atomic weapons and nuclear missiles and
technology disappear!
Therefore, when Sayyidina al-Mahdi (a) comes, first he will proclaim, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha
illa-Llah! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi ‘l-hamd! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
It is shameful to fight Muslims in Sham, Libya, Yemen, Turkey, Tunis and Algeria. This is blame on them!
How do they fight one Muslim to another, Muslims to Muslims? If they are Muslims, don’t they recite the
Holy Qur’an? Amr al-qitaal, the holy orders are to fight unbelievers (in the case of war), not to kill Muslims!
How are you fighting those who say, “laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah.” They will die and their
death will be so difficult! When their souls are taken they will shout in such pain, because they killed Muslims

in such numbers, so (heavenly ones) will take revenge on them. That is Islam!
Also, I am very sad that some people are killing themselves, making themselves like a suicide bomb. That is
haraam, forbidden, to kill himself or herself and also so many innocent people! That is not from Islam. No,
Islam is an open, blessed religion. If they will come forth and fight openly and directly, those whose flags are
up are being supported by Allah; those whose flags are down are supported by Shaytan. O People, so many
things, if we sat here up to next year never ending. But today people are drunk and they don’t look at what
Shari`ah says, and making non-Muslim blame Islam. Their punishment is going to be seventy times an
ordinary punishment. Allah, Allah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar!
O Believers! O Muslims, come and listen to the orders of the Lord of Heavens to you. If there is a mistake or
anything wrong in what I am addressing to you, He knows. He may take me. But if you are not accepting, He
will take you away.
Rajab tara al-`ajabun. In Rajab wonders are seen. Within the next year, maybe the inhabitants of this world
will decrease from five billion to one billion. I am fearing. Don’t follow Shaytan or the Anti-Christ, or
Shaytan’s representatives. You are free, and if you are doing that, you must know a punishment is coming
and every day you must know that one day is coming from your life, one week finishing, one month finishing,
one year finishing, we are approaching to akhirah, to die.
O People! Come to accept Reality that the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (stands and sits) taught
us, he taught us what real Islam is, and follow his way. If not a heavenly punishment will take all people for
punishment!
O People! Say at least seventy times every day, “astaghfirullah.” Don’t use your weapons on innocent people,
on small ones, or weak ones, old ones, women, no, don’t touch them. It is not accepted. Keep yourself on
heavenly directions. Ask for heavenly people and follow them. Heavenly people do not fear their technology
or nuclear missiles. They fear nothing! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Think on it. Allah, Allah. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah. May Allah forgive us. Assalaamu `alaykum.

Fatihah.
Islam says, `ati kulli dhi haqqan haqqah, “Allah gave rights to everyone He created on Earth.” It is haraam to
pass over the rights of others. You don’t have the power just for yourself and make everyone else like
fertilizer! Allah Almighty created them and has given everyone their rights, everyone has been honored!
Therefore, we are asking from east to west, from north to south, that everyone will be given their rights and
be honored. We are not accepting Pharoahs or Nimrods or Abu Jahals, or tyrants, no! You must give
everyone their rights and keep everyone’s honor.
Fatihah.
